entities.summary: Josef Vincent Polišenský was a Czech academic historian and Latin Americanist. He is best known in the English-speaking world for his book Tragic Triangle: The Netherlands, Spain and Bohemia, 1617–1621, a study of the international political context of the Bohemian Revolt.
